scope: Read-only inventory of the 1368 guarded origin observations, with no main attribution, renderer, fixture, or capture changes.

verification.command:
node --input-type=module -e "import assert from'node:assert/strict';import{readFileSync}from'node:fs';import{createHash}from'node:crypto';const hash=b=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');const file='docs/material-origin-request-contexts.json',bytes=readFileSync(file),r=JSON.parse(bytes),stage=JSON.parse(readFileSync(r.priorStageSurvey.file));assert.equal(hash(readFileSync(r.capture.file)),r.capture.sha256);assert.equal(hash(readFileSync(r.priorStageSurvey.file,'utf8').replace(/
/g,'
')),r.priorStageSurvey.normalizedLfSha256);const expected=stage.observations.filter(o=>o.status==='unresolved').map(o=>[o.case,o.element,o.reason,o.inputTrees]);assert.deepEqual(r.observations.map(o=>[o.case,o.element,o.reason,o.inputTrees]),expected);const counts=Array(r.contexts.length).fill(0),files=new Map;for(const o of r.observations){assert.ok(Number.isInteger(o.context)&&o.context>=0&&o.context<counts.length);counts[o.context]++;assert.equal(o.owners.length,r.contexts[o.context].length);for(const x of Object.values(o.inputTrees)){if(files.has(x.file))assert.equal(files.get(x.file),x.sha256);else files.set(x.file,x.sha256);}}for(const [f,h]of files)assert.equal(hash(readFileSync(f)),h,f);for(const f of r.sourceFingerprints)assert.equal(hash(readFileSync(f.file,'utf8').replace(/
/g,'
')),f.sha256,f.file);assert.deepEqual(counts,[540,104,52,152,60,70,70,70,20,20,96,32,32,32,18]);assert.equal(files.size,1644);console.log(JSON.stringify({file,bytes:bytes.length,sha256:hash(bytes),all1368OriginalRowsRetained:true,contexts:counts,treeDigestsVerified:files.size,sourceFingerprintsVerified:r.sourceFingerprints.length}));"
